gui.forever_skyblock.meta.overview_chall: Browse personal Forever, technology, dimension and combat objectives; search and filter completed or open challenges.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.overview_shop: Buy permanent skills, inspect your Shop Tier and review current-world entitlements. Valuable packages are not designed yet.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.overview_resea: Unlock the four Jetpack stages. Creative research costs 40 SP + 1 PP and requires End-Game research.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.contracts_pend:
NOT ACTIVE YET
Repeatable contracts will require proven profile mastery. Resource turn-ins will consume the submitted materials. The unlock tier, quantities and rewards still need balancing. No turn-in or SP reward is available here yet.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.foundation_des: Forever, AE2, Mekanism, Powah, Mystical Agriculture, dimension and combat challenges now earn permanent profile progress where attribution is trustworthy. Ambiguous shared-machine objectives remain disabled rather than guessing an owner.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.no_results_hel: Try a different search or status filter. Additional challenge categories appear only when their implementation is authoritative.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.world_identity:
World: %s
Claims use a hidden stable identity that survives renaming, rejoining, restart and copied saves.
World identity unavailable. Current-world purchases are disabled without creating a replacement identity.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.world_products: The claim and recovery infrastructure is active, but actual package contents, prices and delivery methods remain a separate design phase.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.test_product_d: Development-only world claim. It deliberately grants no item or gameplay benefit. Use it to verify charging, restart recovery and one claim per world.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.world_product_: DEVELOPMENT TEST · CURRENT WORLD · %s SP · Requires Tier %s
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.purchase_confi: Spend %s SP for this entitlement in %s? It cannot be refunded and grants no test item.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.tiers_pending: Tiers 0 and I are active and remain unlocked across worlds and skill resets. Higher tiers and valuable world purchases are not active yet. Points alone never unlock a tier.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.tier_foundatio: Complete First Foundations by personally crafting Cobblestone from four Stone Fragments. Existing completion is recognized without another reward.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.tier_conqueror: Complete Dragon Slayer with a personal Ender Dragon kill. Tier I persists independently of your SP balance.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.tier_engineer_: Proposal, not final: 3 of Quantum Link, Nitro Reactor, Fission Reactor and Industrial Foregoing mastery. Contract access may begin here.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.tier_mastery_d: Requirements open: several proven late-game systems, such as Fusion and Antimatter. Exact conditions and products remain undecided.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.tier_ascended_: Requirements open: Ascension plus multiple endgame capstones. Exceptional products may require PP or SP + PP. No currency exchange is planned.

Available: %s SP and %s PP

gui.forever_skyblock.meta.history_descri: Lifetime earned/spent totals and world claims are not tracked by the current schema. This screen does not reconstruct them from your balance or display invented values.
gui.forever_skyblock.meta.reset_scope: Refund existing skills and Jetpack research. Completed challenges, partial objectives, kill progress, Shop Tier and Core receipts remain.
milestone.forever_skyblock.stoneworker.d: Personally craft Stone Meal from a Mortar and four Stone Fragments.
milestone.forever_skyblock.permanent_too: Personally craft all four permanent Stone tools using the Forever recipes: Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Hoe. Each distinct tool counts once, across worlds.
milestone.forever_skyblock.iron_age.desc: Personally craft all four permanent Iron tools using the Forever recipes: Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Hoe.
milestone.forever_skyblock.diamond_stand: Personally craft a Diamond Pickaxe using the expert recipe with an Iron Pickaxe and Obsidian.
milestone.forever_skyblock.forever_forge: Personally smith a Netherite Pickaxe from a Diamond Pickaxe, an Upgrade Template and Reinforced Netherite Ingot.
milestone.forever_skyblock.beyond_starte: Personally craft your first 4k-or-higher AE2 item storage cell. The prebuilt 1k starter cell does not count.
milestone.forever_skyblock.autocrafting_: Successfully finish an AE2 autocrafting job that was requested by your connected player profile. Machine-only jobs do not grant personal credit.
milestone.forever_skyblock.crafting_brai: Personally craft a 64k Crafting Storage block for your AE2 crafting CPU.
milestone.forever_skyblock.wireless_oper: Successfully open an AE2 Wireless Crafting Terminal. Simply owning the terminal is not enough.
milestone.forever_skyblock.storage_archi: Personally craft a 256k AE2 item storage cell. This also satisfies Beyond the Starter Cell if it was still open.
milestone.forever_skyblock.mekanized.des: Personally craft a Mekanism Metallurgic Infuser.
milestone.forever_skyblock.digital_extra: Have a Digital Miner you own successfully mine its first block while you are online. Merely crafting or placing the machine does not count.
milestone.forever_skyblock.energized.des: Personally take a completed recipe output from a Powah Energizing Orb.
milestone.forever_skyblock.supremium.des: Personally craft Supremium Essence. Receiving or merely storing the item does not count.
milestone.forever_skyblock.into_nether.d: Enter the Nether. This personal challenge pays once across your profile.
milestone.forever_skyblock.withered_away: Defeat a Wither as the player credited with the kill by Minecraft. Nearby players and automated kills do not qualify.
milestone.forever_skyblock.final_dimensi: Enter the End. This personal challenge pays once across your profile.
milestone.forever_skyblock.dragon_slayer: Defeat the Ender Dragon as the player credited with the kill by Minecraft. Permanently unlocks Shop Tier I, including in future worlds. Nearby players receive no credit.
milestone.forever_skyblock.veteran.descr: Personally defeat 1,000 mobs in Minecraft’s Monster category. Each defeated entity counts once. Progress persists across worlds and skill resets; tracking starts with version 0.11.0.

gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.sort.name: A–Z
gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.challenge_: Complete this objective personally. The reward is granted once per permanent profile; opening this screen never grants points.
gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.contract_c: Turning in consumes the required items from your player inventory. Each completed contract awards the displayed SP again. The counter then resets.
gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.contract_a: Qualifying personal boss kills are counted automatically after the original challenge. When the target is reached, SP is awarded and the counter resets. No manual turn-in is needed.
gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.tree_hint: Click a node for details · Lines show tier requirements · Scroll to explore
gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.tier_rules: Tiers unlock through challenges, independently of your SP balance. Purchases and refunds do not reset your tier. Only Tier 0 and Tier I are currently active.
gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.world_upgr: This upgrade applies to the entire current world, including other players. It persists in this save and is not refundable.
gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.world_pack: One purchase per player and current world. The purchase is not refundable. After purchase, claim the package here and open it from your inventory.
gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.confirm_up: Activate %s for %s SP in “%s”? This permanently affects the entire world and is not refundable.
gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.confirm_pa: Buy %s for %s SP in “%s”? This purchase applies only to this world and is not refundable.
gui.forever_skyblock.overhaul.statistics: Playtime, deaths and kills: this player in the current world.
